claims.title: Recover stationary kinetics with known targets or corrected direct blind endpoints

quoted_fields.interface: Fully observed finite named Markov states, column generator W, irreducible unique pi>0, separately accessible stationary laws before/after actual single-pair local interventions. Symmetric barriers multiply BOTH opposed positive rates by unknown t>0,t!=1. Nonzero response requires nonzero baseline pair current. Known-target theorem assumes supplied simple connected bidirected support and active selected edges spanning one cycle-matroid component. Corrected UNKNOWN-target theorem assumes n>=3, distinct active pairs forming a spanning BIDIRECTED BICONNECTED graph. Extra unperturbed rates, including directed one-way rates, allowed in corrected blind case. Hidden states, parallel channels and locality verification are not supplied.
quoted_fields.failure: Recover generator only up to ONE POSITIVE GLOBAL CLOCK; no absolute rates or entropy production per physical time. Equilibrium symmetric barriers are blind, and bridges/articulation blocks can leave distinct scales. Sufficient cycle/biconnectivity assumptions are NOT a full necessity characterization of constrained physical inverse problems. No uniform finite-data guarantee or experimental capability/advantage. The earlier audited blind theorem with 3-vertex-connected selected graph remains valid HISTORY, but graphic-matroid recognition, Whitney reconstruction and row-permutation alignment are UNNECESSARY. CORRECTION.md and its independent audits govern: a CLASSICAL relative-response maximum principle identifies endpoints directly. Hunter2002 Corollary4.1.2/page93 is a direct DTMC relative-response predecessor, not claimed to contain the whole CTMC full-generator theorem. No priority clearance or newly discovered maximum principle.
